context.note: Queue task 352, GH#697, stage S6. CODE-DESIGNER committed the design as commit d1c26c0. Key claim to independently verify: no SERVICE_TASK dispatch orchestrator exists anywhere in the codebase (grepped for decide_failure/ServiceTask. outside service_task.ex, found only one unrelated comment hit) -- confirm this yourself before accepting the design's premise that a new Letflow.Engine.land_service_task_exhaustion/2 function must be added, rather than an existing orchestrator being extended. Design adds: (1) land_service_task_exhaustion/2 in lib/letflow/engine.ex, re-deriving the exhaustion/non-exhaustion split itself (is_retriable_failure(kind) and attempt_index >= retry_limit) since decide_failure/3's return value doesn't carry that distinction, calling Dlq.enqueue/2 directly then delegating to set_instance_error/2 with a new dlq_landed_externally: true opt to prevent double-landing; (2) a new :execution_error_dlq_landing Ecto.Multi step inside ExecutionError.append_multi/3, positioned after :execution_error_event and before :execution_error_projection_update, reading full_reason back from the just-persisted EXECUTION_ERROR event's own JSON payload (not the caller's original string), skipped when opts[:dlq_landed_externally] is true. REQ-176's two open questions resolved: last_failed_at set equal to first_failed_at at landing time by both hooks; exhaustion trigger explicitly is_retriable_failure(kind) AND attempt_index>=retry_limit, distinct from decide_failure/3 simply returning :give_up (which also covers immediate non-retriable failures).
